title: Introduction to C++ (PROG1)
description: Covers the fundamental concepts of C++ programming, including basic program structure, variables, data types, operators, and input/output operations.

title: Basic Syntax and Control Structures (PROG2)
description: Explores C++ syntax rules, formatting, and control structures like sequential execution, conditional statements (if, else, switch), and loops (for, while, do-while).

title: Functions (PROG3)
description: Focuses on modular programming using functions, covering function definition, parameters, arguments, return types, prototypes, and pass-by-value mechanics.
